cinematic.skyabyss.opening.hero2: A quiet morning. And yet something cold sits at the bottom of my chest.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.heaven1: The sky has not gone to sleep.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.heaven2: Follow the smoke. To where people are.
cinematic.skyabyss.opening.goal: Goal: head for the rising smoke
cinematic.skyabyss.whale.hero2: No. That is a living thing.
cinematic.skyabyss.whale.heaven: That is the Stone Whale. The first of the titans that cross the sky.
cinematic.skyabyss.whale.hero3: Something like that, in this sky...
cinematic.skyabyss.first.tide_shell.hero: ...The island out at sea is moving.
Not an island. A great shell.
cinematic.skyabyss.first.tide_shell.heav: That is the Tide Shell. The second titan, who crosses the sea.
cinematic.skyabyss.first.tide_shell.hero: Even the sea holds something like that...
cinematic.skyabyss.first.thunder_wing.he: Wings. The storm itself is beating them.
That is the Thunder Wing. The third titan, who carries the storm.
cinematic.skyabyss.first.ember.hero2: Not a volcano. A creature that swims through the earth.
cinematic.skyabyss.first.ember.heaven: That is the Ember. The fourth titan, who crosses the deep earth.
cinematic.skyabyss.first.ember.hero3: The ground under my feet is warm...
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.stone_whale.hea: At the bottom of the stone chest, one heartbeat wakes.
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.tide_shell.heav: On the seabed, a pearl begins to pulse.
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.tide_shell.hero: The same beat as the ebbing tide.
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.thunder_wing.he: In the eye of the storm, a heartbeat calls the thunder.
It beats at the pace of the lightning.
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.ember.heaven: Beneath the ash, an ember begins to keep time.
cinematic.skyabyss.heart.ember.hero: The warmth under my feet is beating.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.stone_whale.2: It isn't dead. It is sinking into sleep.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.stone_whale.3: The beat goes down. Far, far down.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.tide_shell.1: The sound of the waves is fading.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.tide_shell.2: The shell returns to the sea; only its coral terraces remain.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.thunder_wing.1: The wings fold. The lightning ceases.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.thunder_wing.2: It looks like nothing but a crag.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.thunder_wing.3: Even asleep, the storm remembers the sky.
cinematic.skyabyss.end.ember.2: The embers bury themselves and become a hill.
